authority: Grounded in the skill's review-workflow-uac.md domain contract, with Experience League source approval recorded per feature.
note: Only entries with explicit Human approval and a reviewed Experience League source may enter the governed feature map. Other entries remain pending.

native_features.feature: review task membership and selected-task state
native_features.candidate_template: when View all review tasks is enabled, the task dropdown lists the indexed review tasks associated with the open topic, marks Current by default, and opens a selected non-Current task's topic version and comments read-only
supported task states show the correct labels and drive read-only/editable/importable behaviour

native_features.feature: review comments, threads, replies and tags
native_features.candidate_template: comments, replies, tags, and authors render for the selected task/version and do not leak across tasks or topics
importing or incorporating comments changes only the approved target version/content and is idempotent or duplicate-safe
comparison names both sides and the topic identity and associates the correct comments/tags/replies with each version, not just opening a diff window

native_features.feature: review panel / task dropdown and details
native_features.candidate_template: the Review panel task dropdown and Review details show the selected task's name, review version, status, and comments, and switching tasks changes that selected-task context
view tasks/comments, import/incorporate, open details, compare versions, and download attachments each enforce the correct role/permission, and denied actions do not mutate content

native_features.feature: review search and filter within loaded task scope
native_features.candidate_template: search and filter operate on the approved loaded scope and hidden or unloaded task data does not influence results unless cross-task search is in scope
switching the open topic resets or preserves task selection per the approved state contract and leaves unrelated task/topic data unchanged
reviewer display name and its fallback behave per current implementation, including missing-name cases, without relying on historical UI text
